data.narrative:
Zettascale is a seed-stage semiconductor company founded by self-taught engineer Elias Almqvist and Cambridge-trained ML researcher Prithvi Raj (ex-Microsoft). The company has raised $3M+ to date. The chips & semiconductors sector comprises 13 identifiable private peers (including Cerebras, SambaNova Systems, and Etched) and 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD).

Given data constraints, only one valuation method proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $3M total raised as a base proxy and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier, implies a valuation of $7.5M. Peer-median analysis is inapplicable: while 13 same-sector peers exist, fewer than three qualify within narrow filters (same stage, adjacent stage, similar valuation tier), precluding reliable median extraction. Public-comp anchoring cannot proceed without disclosed revenue; the sector median P/S of 18.9x across three public semiconductors is uninformative for a private, pre-revenue entity.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M–$9M, centered at $8M. This range reflects standard early-stage progression mechanics applied to stated capitalization, absent deeper fundamentals. Key uncertainties are substantial: the absence of comparable private financings at identical stage and focus, lack of revenue or near-term milestones, and founder track record in capital-intensive hardware. Investor conviction must rest largely on team credentials and market timing rather than quantitative peer benchmarking.
